shortDescription: Libya's National Oil Corporation on Sunday announced the opening of a gas field south of Brega, with production capacity of up to 50 million cubic feet per day.Al-Rashad oilfield will help increase gas supplies to the coastal network for use in power generation and heavy industry, the NOC said.
